submission.justification:
Mixture-G2 with a 2mm gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.89 ns across all simulated configurations. The simulation data shows:
- At 1mm gap: G2 = 1.045 ns, G1 = 1.513 ns, G3 = 2.261 ns
- At 2mm gap: G2 = 0.89 ns, G1 = 1.27 ns, G3 = 2.016 ns  
- At 3mm gap: G2 = 1.028 ns, G1 = 1.504 ns, G3 = 2.189 ns

Mixture-G2 consistently outperforms the other candidates at all gap widths, with the 2mm gap providing the optimal balance. This configuration delivers approximately 30% better time resolution than G1 and 56% better than G3 at the same gap width. The 2mm gap is well within the specified constraints and represents a practical middle ground that should facilitate reliable detector operation while achieving superior timing performance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 at 2mm gap achieves 0.89 ns time resolution, which is the best result among all simulated configurations (better than 0.9 ns from 2025 simulation data and significantly better than G1 and G3 alternatives)

requirements.evidence: Gas recirculation system with 90% recovery rate has been confirmed (gas_recirculation_recovery_percent = 90), indicating compliance with environmental policies. All candidate mixtures have been reviewed against laboratory policies (documents_reviewed = 6)
Recommended gap of 2mm is within the specified range of 1-3mm (gap_min_mm = 1, gap_max_mm = 3, recommended_gap_mm = 2)
